{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
table = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract the difference: email minus paid_search
difference = table['email'] - table['paid_search']

# Print the difference value exactly as it will be used in evidence
print(difference)"}
